name: PlotterNodes
description: Pen plotter drawing nodes: concentric offsets and halos around any Dynamo curves, hand-drawn wobble, background patterns (nested rectangles, circle clusters, framed grids, spirals), pen layers and AxiDraw-ready SVG export. Canvas 3D shows geometry in a separate window for a second monitor, with Arctic (ambient occlusion) display.
contents: Plotter.Shape, Plotter.Polyline, Plotter.DistanceField, Plotter.Pattern, Plotter.Layer, Plotter.Drawing, Plotter.Page, Plotter.Noise, Plotter.View.Canvas 3D
